## Beta — Overnight rules

Schedules that cross midnight now work without any extra setting. If a slot has an end time earlier than its start time (e.g. Monday 22:00 → 06:00) and no explicit end day, the end action fires the **next day**. An explicit `end_day` still always wins.

- **Scheduler and calendar**: the end action and the calendar event now use the computed end day (`effective_end_day` in `slots.py`).
- **Weekly card**: the block runs to the bottom of the grid on the start day and continues from the top of the next day's column up to the end time. Clicking the continuation opens the same rule.
- Known limit: slots spanning more than two days (e.g. Friday → Sunday) don't paint the days in between.

Please test with a rule like 22:00 → 06:00 and check both the card and when the end action fires.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/andker87/Home-Assistant-ChronoTask/compare/v1.3.0...v1.4.0-beta1
